faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about subscriptions and payment.

questions.a: Yes, we offer a 14-day free trial of the Pro plan with all its features, so you can experience the platform with your real project data before making a decision.

questions.q: Can I upgrade or cancel my subscription at any time?
questions.a: Certainly. You can upgrade to a higher plan at any time and only the relative difference will be calculated. You can also cancel auto-renewal whenever you want.
It is calculated based on the number of active accounts that can log in to the system (such as engineers, accountants, management). Workers added to the system are not counted as users.
We use the latest encryption protocols and protected cloud servers hosted locally to ensure 100% confidentiality and security of your data.

cta.title: Do you have special needs?

hero_new.tagline: The Next Generation of Construction Management
hero_new.desc: Sojin turns every dollar in your project into a clear number. From petty cash to invoices. From attendance to profits. No paper, no guesswork.

why.title_2: And you are the last to know.
why.desc: Every day without accurate financial control is a real loss that only appears in your books when it's too late.

cards.d: Petty cash uncleared for months. Invoices without documents. Money evaporates with no trace.
You don't know what was spent today. Relying on WhatsApp calls instead of data. Decisions by intuition.
Contractors demand amounts that don't match actual progress on the ground. No one verifies.
Fast and smart clearance. Every amount spent is linked to its invoice. No open cash without a document.
Automatic invoice generation based on actual progress. Instant management review before payment.
Site attendance tracking. Calculate actual labor cost vs planned budget. Complete transparency.
Comprehensive visual dashboard. Know profit, loss, and cash flows for each project with one click.
Advanced permissions. Each employee interacts only with what concerns them. Enterprise-grade security.
Instant notifications to management when budgets are exceeded or delivery schedules are delayed.

steps.d: Engineer submits daily needs directly from the app in seconds.
System matches request with project budget automatically for easy approval.
Upload invoices and receipts from mobile. Cash clearance is done automatically.
Project P&L and all cost details are available instantly.

testimonial.quote: Before Sojin, we were losing 12% of profits per project due to manual calculations. Now every penny is accounted for, visible, and under control.
testimonial.author: Eng. Khalid Al-Otaibi
